header.title: COMPAGENT-XRLF Automated Refactoring & Streamlining Steering Directive
header.author: XRLF Protocol Optimization Engine
header.objective: Refactor legacy multi-agent Docker/Python REST pipeline into a low-latency, distilled vLLM streaming engine for WebXR.

execution_rules.rule: DO NOT spawn parallel build tasks or unthrottled loop tests.
Enforce a 5-minute cooldown between heavy model evaluations or dataset generation tasks to prevent thermal throttling.
Run git commits automatically after each successfully passing module test.

agent.responsibility: Code cleanup, directory consolidation, dependency pruning, and Python-to-C++/Rust wrapper scaffolding.
agent.scope: Backend container structure, service consolidation, environment configurations.

agent.responsibility: Multi-agent distillation logic, prompt compression, vLLM/llama.cpp integration, AWQ/FP8 quantization setup.
agent.scope: LLM engine, system prompts, agent state collapse (Reflexive + Director + Archetypes into single model weights).

agent.responsibility: Replacing REST HTTP base64 payloads with persistent WebSockets / WebRTC audio/text binary streaming.
agent.scope: FastAPI/Rust networking layers, streaming state machine, XRLF token parser.

agent.responsibility: Client decoupling, procedural WebXR animation loops, dynamic bone retargeting, and gesture-tag parsing.
agent.scope: WebXR frontend scripts, audio player buffer management, tag listener.

phase.name: Audit and Multi-Agent Knowledge Distillation
phase.instructions: 1. Inspect existing multi-agent interaction logs (Reflexive Local, Cloud Super-Ego, Director Manager, Archetype rules) [cite: ]. 2. Apply Process-Aware Distillation (PAD) principles to extract the core decision trajectories into a consolidated dataset [cite: 3, 4]. 3. Create an XRLF system prompt template that embeds the psychological and spiritual growth parameters directly into the primary model prompt context [cite: 5]. 4. Prune redundant sub-agent containers and legacy test scripts from the repository.
phase.verification: Verified distillation dataset compiled without crashing host system memory.

phase.name: Inference Engine Migration (vLLM / Speculative Decoding)
phase.instructions: 1. Deploy a unified vLLM or llama.cpp backend serving a single 8B AWQ-quantized base model. 2. Configure speculative decoding using a small 0.5B draft model to maximize token generation speeds [cite: 5]. 3. Implement dynamic LoRA loading support inside vLLM for specialized agent behavior switching without restarting models. 4. Deprecate separate synchronous HTTP requests for ChromaDB/Redis by creating an async memory background worker.
phase.verification: vLLM server streams tokens under 50ms Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) at medium GPU usage.

phase.name: Transport Protocol Refactoring (WebSockets Streaming)
phase.instructions: 1. Remove REST HTTP POST base64 endpoints from FastAPI backend. 2. Implement a high-speed WebSocket protocol for bi-directional streaming: user audio chunks in -> text tokens & synthesized audio out. 3. Integrate inline animation parsing (e.g., `[gesture:nod]`) directly inside the text streaming channel.
phase.verification: Zero dropped frames in WebXR while maintaining continuous binary audio streaming over WebSockets.

phase.name: WebXR Frontend Optimization & Testing
phase.instructions: 1. Refactor client frame loops to run micro-animations, blinking, and eye contact asynchronously in Web Workers. 2. Connect the WebXR avatar controller directly to incoming WebSocket token/gesture streams. 3. Run end-to-end latency benchmarks and confirm system stability under throttled compute settings.
phase.verification: Full interactive loop functioning smoothly in WebXR at target frame rates.

matrix_item.data: Pruned codebase structure & consolidated prompt definitions.
vLLM output token streaming hook & LoRA adapter triggers.
Binary WebSocket interface specification and animation tag schemas.

output_targets.target: Streamlined, low-latency, single-container or unified binary architecture.
Sub-200ms end-to-end voice-to-response latency for WebXR.
Clean git history with modular, maintainable, and fully documented XRLF refactored files.
